name: Palmr
description: Palmr is a fast, self-hosted file-sharing platform — a flexible alternative to WeTransfer, SendGB, and Send Anywhere. Runs as a Docker container with bundled MinIO storage; no external dependencies required for default zero-config setup.

notes.text: The bundled storage system listens on port 9379 and is referenced by STORAGE_URL in /opt/palmr/docker-compose.yml. STORAGE_URL must be reachable from your browser — install defaults to the LXC's primary IPv4. Override it for a stable hostname or HTTPS reverse-proxy setup.
To put Palmr behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, set SECURE_SITE: "true" in /opt/palmr/docker-compose.yml and update STORAGE_URL to your public storage URL.
Update with `cd /opt/palmr && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` or rerun the installer's update mode.
